title: On Showing the licence at the gate
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）　|　核心词汇：show　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 show 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1975 the observer ① showed the licence at the gate without complaint, and every assistant in the observatory said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the observer ② shows the licence at the gate with great care without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ show the licence at the gate at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ shown the licence at the gate before — a line in the log for November 1969 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Showing the licence at the gate without complaint, the observer said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the lens at the far dome, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ show no fear before the crowd with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Show no fear before the crowd at once and never mention it again.

By 1982 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the log, and a new assistant from the next observatory ⑧ shows no fear before the crowd without complaint every night without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the dome, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ showed the licence at the gate again when nobody else would.

⑩ To show the licence at the gate, my mother said in 1987, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the observatory remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the observatory forgets, somebody shows the licence at the gate with great care again and somebody must show the licence at the gate without complaint all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 出示（一般过去式 showed the licence at the gate：1975 年观测员头一回这样做，毫无怨言地）
B. v. 出示（一般现在 shows the licence at the gate：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 出示（不定式 to show the licence at the gate：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 出示（过去完成时 had shown the licence at the gate：1969 年十一月的观测记录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 出示（动名词 showing the licence at the gate 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 表明（show no fear before the crowd：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去表明在众人面前毫不露怯）
G. v. 表明（show no fear before the crowd：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 出示（后段两处：新来的助手照例 shows no fear before the crowd，而母亲又一次 showed the licence at the gate）

show 意为“出示”，自那以后观测员小心翼翼地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 shows。

show 意为“出示”，结尾那句是母亲 1987 年的话：要出示在门口出示那张执照，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和观测站记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 show 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1975 the observer showed the licence at the gate without complaint, and nobody in the observatory forgot it.
Even now the observer shows the licence at the gate with great care whenever the observatory asks.
Showing the licence at the gate without complaint, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever show no fear before the crowd with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new assistant from the next observatory shows no fear before the crowd without complaint every night, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother showed the licence at the gate again, and the observatory remembered that half.
